witness.branch: Police officer direction to a bus driver.
witness.quote: the directions of a police officer at a railroad crossing
witness.reason: A bus driver's intended railway crossing on a paved road can be governed by an officer's actual direction.
required_context: Bus classification and person actually driving; school-bus status is not inferred.
Do not infer a priority rule for conflicting instructions or an unconditional duty to stop at every crossing.
Establish an at-grade railroad crossing with supported bus clearance and exit space.
Establish bus classification, included vehicle status and the person actually driving; do not infer school-bus status.
Establish the officer's qualifying authorization, actual direction, intended recipient, crossing applicability and temporal scope.
Officer location, qualifying authorization and direction governing the bus crossing movement; presence alone establishes no order.
Record direction and communication history with the bus's motion and response; document complete cessation if a stop is directed.
Supported crossing with bus clearances and exit space.
witness.subject_reason: A person driving an ordinary motor bus is a driver of a vehicle; specialized bus status does not remove that subject relationship.
